case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your alternative proposals and are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms. However, the prices you suggested are not feasible for our foundry. We can offer €51.40 under these extended terms, which is a significant step towards your position. 

For our current Angebot, we present a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. Our foundry values the long relationship we share with your company, and we take great pride in delivering the quality you expect from our region. We trust this proposal reflects our strong desire to work together constructively.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying high-quality castings to your respected company, and we deeply value the long partnership between our houses.

In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.40 for the 24-month contract. Our complete offer stands at a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

While we are glad to accommodate your business, we expect a more substantial step from your side to close the remaining gap. We remain confident that we can find a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
